On Tue, May 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM tessa_morgan@redwood.com wrote:
> Forwarding Nimbus's redlines — they want a turnaround by 5/12.

I've pulled key redlines into a short runbook (Execution_Runbook_v1.pdf) — includes who owns each step and the target SLA for approvals. High-level recommendations:
1) Keep pass-through fee language but require that Nimbus provide monthly invoice details and a 45-day claims window; this limits audit/chargeback exposure.
2) 12-month attribution is okay from a GTM perspective, but we should add a renewal-trigger exception (if a customer renews via Redwood direct within 6 months, attribution re-assessment applies).
3) Insist on a mutual indemnity carve-out for data residency incidents and limit the audit frequency to once per 12 months unless there's reasonable suspicion.

I attached the runbook and a risk matrix CSV that scores exposure levels for finance/legal/ops. I recommend we propose these as tracked changes and request a 30-minute alignment call with Nimbus.

Marissa
Director, Partnerships Operations

Attachments: Execution_Runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 92 KB); Risk_Matrix_Reseller_Onboarding.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@nimbuscloud.com>, contracts@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum (initial redlines)

Hi J.,

Thanks for sending this over and for the timeline — we can target 5/12. We've reviewed the attribution and pass-through sections and propose the following narrow edits (attached as inline redlines):
- Keep 12-month attribution but add a renewal-trigger carve-out (described in the inline comment).
- Pass-through fee: require monthly invoicing and 45-day dispute window; Redwood will not assume liability for third-party tax assessments unless proven due to Redwood's negligence.
- Audit: limit to one annual audit; for any additional requests, require documented cause.

Laura, please review the indemnity & limitation language in the attached redlines; if OK, we'll upload to your review docket. J., Marissa and I are available 5/7 afternoon for a 30-min alignment call — does 3:00 PM PT work?

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Contracts & Partner Legal

Attachments: Reseller_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx (Microsoft Word, with redlines)

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear runbook. 3:00 PM PT on 5/7 works for me; I'll have our legal lead on the call and we'll aim to close the outstanding items.

A couple of quick confirmations before the call:
- We'll accept the audit cadence constraint if Redwood provides a contact for evidence requests and a standard template for invoice detail.
- On the renewal-trigger carve-out: we can accept language that protects existing attribution for 12 months, but ask that the carve-out only applies when the renewal is initiated by Nimbus customers through our portal.

Looking forward to the call.

Best regards,
J. Sullivan
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Nimbus Cloud
